1.1.0.0.added: - Registry callback before deciding which backend to use so I can init Pipelab before trying to load the save file
1.1.0.0.changed: - Paths are matched cross platform, cross export options.

1.1.1.0.changed: Changed priority order for Auto Backend

1.3.0.0.added:
- On load failed trigger, fired when a load fails after retries
- LastErrorOperation expression: "load", "save", "delete" or "check"
- Automatic backup of an unreadable or corrupt save before defaults are applied
- Operations are serialised per instance, so projects no longer need their own save mutex
1.3.0.0.changed:
- BREAKING: "On error" is now "On any error" and must be re-picked in event sheets
- Node.js backend is fully async and writes atomically (temp file + rename)
- Pipelab writes atomically (temp file + move with overwrite)
1.3.0.0.fixed:
- A failed load could present as a fresh install, and the next save would overwrite the real one
- A bad default data path was only surfaced much later, via New save

1.4.0.0.added:
- Save name property. Leave it blank to keep using the object's name, or set it so renaming the object no longer hides existing saves
- Warning when two Save Managers resolve to the same save file

1.5.0.0.added:
- Reveal save location action, plus an optional reveal() method for custom handlers
- SaveRelativePath expression: the path from the selected folder down
- On reveal error trigger
1.5.0.0.changed:
- ACEs are split into Save Manager, Errors and File system categories
- SavePath now returns the full path on Node.js and Pipelab. On Webview it returns a platform path using an environment token, since the real path cannot be read there
- With Auto load off, the default data is now loaded into the JSON object at startup instead of leaving it untouched
1.5.0.0.fixed: - SavePath was missing the root folder on the Node.js backend
